name: TypeGPU Runtime Adapter
summary: Integrate TypeGPU and WebGPU visuals into HyperFrames with deterministic timeline seeking.
problem: GPU-driven visuals may depend on an uncontrolled render loop and become inconsistent when frames are sampled out of order.
coreOutcomes: Build a TypeGPU visual runtime for a composition
Derive visual state from the requested timeline position
Handle WebGPU capability and render validation explicitly
requirements: A browser and device with the required WebGPU support
boundaries: Covers runtime animation integration, not general GPU programming or asset licensing
